body.label: Target
body.html: Self and up to two willing allies within 4 units.

body.label: Effect
body.html: Unopposed. Each target detects ordinary moving creatures within 2 units through concealment until the start of your next turn; no sight passes through solid barriers. Each gains +1 Composure against sensory effects.

surges.html: One target may move 2 units toward another protected creature; alone, move freely.
Each target ignores one ordinary concealment penalty on its next Combat Card until the start of your next turn.

rider.title: Full Manifestation - Ancestor
rider.html: You may burn 3 Action Dice and spend 3 Mana to enter Ancestor Full Manifestation (FM-2A). It replaces you; use its profile. Dice, Resources, Movement spent and recorded injuries do not refresh.
